title: Dual-Part Multi-Lateral Branched Network for Multi-Class Segmentation in Cardiovascular Catheterization Angiograms
abstract: arXiv:2609.04590v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Catheterisation image processing requires segmentation models that are fast, accurate and explainable. While most of the existing studies usually focus on binary segmentation, there is a recent demand for simultaneous segmentation of multiple structures found in catheterization scenes. In this study, a dual-part MLBNet architecture is designed with multi-lateral encoder blocks and multi-head decoder branches for class-aware segmentation in cardiovascular catheterization scenes. Lateral branches in the encoder enables repeated feature extraction to learn diverse shared representations, while multiple decoder heads are used to introduce class-skewed branches that specialize in different structural properties in catheterization scenes. translated_title: 用于心血管导管造影图像多类别分割的双部件多侧分支网络
translated_abstract: 导管图像处理需要快速、准确且可解释的分割模型。虽然现有的大多数研究通常专注于二值分割，但最近出现了对导管场景中多个结构进行同时分割的需求。在本研究中，设计了一种双部件MLBNet架构，该架构采用多侧编码器块和多解码器分支，用于心血管导管场景中的类别感知分割。编码器中的侧向分支能够进行重复的特征提取，以学习多样化的共享表示，而多个解码器头用于引入类别偏斜的分支，专门处理导管场景中不同的结构特性。为了分析双部件MLBNet架构的性能，研究使用了在体模模型、合成人体模拟条件下进行心血管导管造影时获得的多个多类别分割血管造影片数据……
tldr: 提出了一种双部件多侧分支网络MLBNet，通过多侧编码器块和多解码器分支，实现了心血管导管造影图像中多个结构的类别感知同步分割。
en_tdlr: A dual-part MLBNet architecture with multi-lateral encoder blocks and multi-head decoder branches is proposed for class-aware simultaneous segmentation of multiple structures in cardiovascular catheterization angiograms.
